questions.question: The apostle Paul taught believers to put off their former way of life. What did he call it?
The apostle Paul wrote "Be angry, yet do not sin." What deadline did he give for anger?

answers.text: Do not let the sun set on it

questions.question: The apostle Paul told a man who had been stealing to work with his own hands. What reason did he give?

answers.text: To have something to share with the one in need
To pay back everyone he ever stole from
To earn back his good name around town

questions.question: The apostle Paul told believers to forgive each other. How did he say they should forgive?

answers.text: Just as in Christ God forgave them
As each one confesses his sin
Seven times and then no more
